title: Nuclear Fallout Protection
description: Interactive guide with the actions for the first 10 minutes (get inside, seal the space, clean up if you were outside) and how fallout decays under the 7-10 rule. Compares protection factors from a wood house to an underground shelter and covers water and food safety, information sources, and when it's safe to leave.
shortDescription: First 10 minutes, the 7-10 rule, shelter protection factors, and leaving
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
